title: A Two-Level Clinical Novelty Prioritization Framework for Disease Trajectories Discovered from Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
abstract: arXiv:2610.20512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph-based analysis of electronic health records (EHRs) yields disease-trajectory catalogs, but structural support does not establish semantic novelty. We present a two-level framework to prioritize 99,527 branching motifs previously discovered by an upstream patient-disjoint, train-only MIMIC-IV v3.1 pipeline and frozen after validation-based catalog selection. The framework separates path-level and node-to-endpoint semantic sparsity from reliability-adjusted clinical priority. Three deterministic textualizations per motif or node-target pair were embedded with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 and calibrated against 166,972 pre-2023 PubMed references using mean top-20 cosine distance. Positive recombination occurred in 8.63% of motifs and had negligible effect on global ranking, whereas specificity and support/GNN reliability terms changed clinical-priority ordering. translated_title: 一种针对从纵向电子健康记录中发现的疾病轨迹的两级临床新颖性优先级排序框架
translated_abstract: 基于图的电子健康记录（EHR）分析可以生成疾病轨迹目录，但结构上的支持并不能确立语义上的新颖性。我们提出了一个两级框架，用于对之前由上游患者不重叠、仅基于训练集的 MIMIC-IV v3.1 流水线发现并在基于验证的目录选择后冻结的 99,527 个分支模体进行优先级排序。该框架将路径级与节点到终点的语义稀疏性同经可靠性调整的临床优先级分离开来。对每个模体或节点-目标对进行三种确定性文本化处理，使用 BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 进行嵌入，并通过平均 top-20 余弦距离与 166,972 篇 2023 年之前的 PubMed 参考文献进行校准。结果表明，正向重组出现在 8.63% 的模体中，对全局排名的影响可以忽略不计，而特异性和支持度/GNN 可靠性项则改变了临床优先级的排序。此外还开展了跨邻居数量、模板、编码器及通用标签设置的鲁棒性分析（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个两级框架，将疾病轨迹分支模体的语义稀疏性与经可靠性调整的临床优先级分离，从而对从纵向电子健康记录中发现的 99,527 个模体进行新颖性评估和临床优先级排序。
en_tdlr: A two-level framework that separates semantic sparsity from reliability-adjusted clinical priority to assess novelty and rank 99,527 disease-trajectory branching motifs discovered from longitudinal electronic health records, calibrated against PubMed literature via embedding-based distance metrics.
